Georgia Investor Property Repair

You need reliable property repair services for your investment properties in Georgia, and Build Heritage is here to help. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your repair needs, and learn more about the services offered for investors like you.

How it Works for Investors

Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. The company offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, and roofing, to help you maintain and repair your investment properties. You can contact them through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. They will respond within one business day.

What You Get and What it Costs

The cost of services varies, but you can expect to pay between $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint, or $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement. It's also recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia, giving you peace of mind when working with them.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can get a free, written, and itemized quote by contacting Build Heritage through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. What trades do you offer? Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.

Get your free quote today
